prompt:

Canvas: exact 2 columns × 2 rows, equal cells, overall aspect ratio 64:35 (about 1.83:1), each cell represents a native 64×35 eye-area crop. No gutters, margins, labels, borders, text, or extra panels. Row-major order: top-left LEFT/open; top-right RIGHT/open; bottom-left LEFT/half; bottom-right RIGHT/half. Both eyes glance together in each cell.

Keep both small pupils fully inside the source opening and naturally bounded by the existing lids.

No broad bright sclera bands, large pale patches, bright-white glare, increased contrast, oversized irises, perfect circles, or new shiny reflections. Tiny restrained glints only at the source's original subdued intensity. Do not change brows, forehead, hair, skin, nose, face, background, crop, or anything outside the eye features. Preserve crisp native pixel edges; no smoothing, blur, antialiasing, resampling, or invented colors. Return only the requested four cells, with no closed or vertical gaze.
